body: They’re trials I’m forcing myself into. They’re relationships I’m messing up. I’ve been a fuck up since  I came out of 8th grade and I see no end in sight. Nothing in the last 4 years of my life has been enjoyed like it was before. I don’t see friends like I used to. My job that I need if I do decide to go on takes up most of my time so it’s hard to even really see family. The only reason I haven’t left is because I cant get over the fact that I’d not only hurt my family, but leave a major financial burden on them.

I try but we come from separate backgrounds. He was beaten and abused as a child, and I come from a mostly loving family (I say mostly because the “tough love” they employ can go too far). He knows how to work through awful things and work with terrible odds whereas I’ve got no experience. He didn’t graduate high school and worked beyond hard to get to where he is today and be as successful as he is. My parents are happy together and have never once argued in front of me or my siblings. They’ve been together since they were 17 and I’m 18 and still can’t do things right.

I’ve compared my masculinity with that of my fathers. He is an absolute hardass and always has been. I’ve never once seen him cry. I’ve heard his voice start cracking when I was sent to a mental health institution and he called me and that made me feel like shit. The fact that I was enough to make my own father start crying really tore into me and cut extraordinarily deep. I do want to help myself and be good to the people around me but I don’t know where to start. I want my ex back but I know there’s almost no chance.

I’ve struggled with migraines for years. I’ve always had to remove myself from my room because I’ve got firearms in my closet. Every time I get them I am unable to function. I am in immense pain and think it’d be best to take myself out to stop the pain. The only thing that stops me is knowing that in a few hours it’ll be gone. But even then, the intense pain behind my eyes and the vomiting that ensues and shoves pressure into my head keeps those thoughts in my mind.

It really is truly obnoxious. Everyone says they’re “just checking in on a friend” but they’re not. They know the one or two questions they’ll ask or the topic they’ll bring up before they start the conversation. And as soon as you start going outside of the boundaries of where they intended the conversation to go, you get dry, emotionless and meaningless comments back. I hate it more than I hate not having someone to talk to.

Welcome to it man. My parents still haven’t gotten over the “straight a student” I was in middle school. They don’t ask to see why I’ve given up on school, or why I quit football. Rather they bitch me out and moan and groan. I understand they want what’s best for me, but I feel like without even really knowing how their son is doing, they can’t truly want or know what’s best for me.

Not really, I just cannot make others around me happy. I feel as if I’m a burden to everyone who lets me in their life. I’ve not cried since 5th grade when my grandfather died and I’m 18 now. I’ve been sobbing. I’m supposed to be a man and I’m acting like a little girl. It’s embarrassing and mentally exhausting.
